responsibility: This source file is the procedural implementation of the H8/300 backend’s target hooks and support routines that cannot be expressed in the .md machine descriptions or macro header. It owns core target behavior for operand and address printing, instruction and addressing-length calculation, register and RTL cost modeling, argument passing and return-value conventions, frame layout and saved-register computation, prologue/epilogue support helpers, function and variable attributes and pragmas (including interrupt/saveall/monitor-style handling and tiny/eight-bit data placement), trampoline emission for nested functions, target-specific reorganization, libfunc initialization, option override logic, and the final TARGET_INITIALIZER hook table that connects the H8 port to GCC’s backend interfaces.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the sibling h8300.h header, h8300.md machine description, and h8300.opt option table, this file is the executable C backend implementation for the H8 port: it defines the target-hook functions and support routines those declarative/configuration files rely on, then binds them into TARGET_INITIALIZER.
